description: TAOM (Tales From the Age of Men). Lines from the project's own tester checklist that are assertions about state rather than about how something looks. Run install.json first - if the campaign is not loaded, everything here is vacuous.

checks.why: A module present on disk but not enabled in the launcher produces exactly the symptoms of a broken mod.
TAOM resolves HarmonyLib and UIExtenderEx through it. A missing or stale copy fails at the member level, the preview patches never apply, and every character renders in bind pose (issue #371).
The first line of the tester checklist, and the most visible content bug there is.

checks.what: Every character resolved an equipment roster
checks.why: No roster resolved usually means a roster id that nothing in the modlist defines - a typo in an XSLT or a file that never registered.
A troop with no weapon in any slot stands still in battle.

TAOM_Map's settlements.xslt strips all vanilla settlements, so a culture that gets none is reachable. Vanilla SpawnLordParty then throws on the daily clan tick - a crash to desktop with no TAOM frame in the stack.

checks.what: Every culture has a basic troop
checks.why: Recruitment resolves the culture's basic troop; without one, villages of that culture offer nothing.
Includes exceptions TAOM caught and swallowed, which never reach any log. Clear the collector before reproducing, or this counts throws from earlier in the session.
The dependency is LOTRLOME_Armory, not Armory_2. Item definitions live there; without it, equipment ids resolve to nothing and characters strip.
